lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh ubare saachaa naam samaal ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are saved, by contemplating the True Name. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਲਂੀ ਅਸੀ ਚੰਗੀਆ ਆਚਾਰੀ ਬੁਰੀਆਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: gala(n)ee asee cha(n)geeaa aachaaree bureeaah ||
lines.translation: We are good at talking, but our actions are bad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਹੁ ਕੁਸੁਧਾ ਕਾਲੀਆ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਚਿਟਵੀਆਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: manahu kusudhaa kaaleeaa baahar chitaveeaah ||
lines.translation: Mentally, we are impure and black, but outwardly, we appear white.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੀਸਾ ਕਰਿਹ ਤਿਨਾੜੀਆ ਜੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਦਰੁ ਖੜੀਆਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: reesaa karih tinaaReeaa jo sevahi dar khaReeaah ||
lines.translation: We imitate those who stand and serve at the Lord's Door.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਲਿ ਖਸਮੈ ਰਤੀਆ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਰਲੀਆਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: naal khasamai rateeaa maanahi sukh raleeaah ||
lines.translation: They are attuned to the Love of their Husband Lord, and they experience the pleasure of His Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਦੈ ਤਾਣਿ ਨਿਤਾਣੀਆ ਰਹਹਿ ਨਿਮਾਨਣੀਆਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: hodai taan nitaaneeaa rahahi nimaananeeaah ||
lines.translation: They remain powerless, even while they have power; they remain humble and meek.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਕਾਰਥਾ ਜੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਹ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak janam sakaarathaa je tin kai sa(n)g milaah ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, our lives become profitable if we associate with them. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਜਲੁ ਮੀਨਾ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਜਾਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) aape jal meenaa hai aape aape hee aap jaal ||
lines.translation: You Yourself are the water, You Yourself are the fish, and You Yourself are the net.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਲੁ ਵਤਾਇਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੇਬਾਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) aape jaal vataaidaa aape vich sebaal ||
lines.translation: You Yourself cast the net, and You Yourself are the bait.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਕਮਲੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਹੈ ਸੈ ਹਥਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਲਾਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) aape kamal alipat hai sai hathaa vich gulaal ||
lines.translation: You Yourself are the lotus, unaffected and still brightly-colored in hundreds of feet of water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਘੜੀ ਕਰਿ ਖਿਆਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) aape mukat karaaidaa ik nimakh ghaRee kar khiaal ||
lines.translation: You Yourself liberate those who think of You for even an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: har tudhahu baahar kichh nahee gurasabadee vekh nihaal ||7||
lines.translation: O Lord, nothing is beyond You. I am delighted to behold You, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukam na jaanai bahutaa rovai ||
lines.translation: One who does not know the Hukam of the Lord's Command cries out in terrible pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਧੋਖਾ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dar dhokhaa need na sovai ||
lines.translation: She is filled with deception, and she cannot sleep in peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਧਨ ਖਸਮੈ ਚਲੈ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: je dhan khasamai chalai rajaaee ||
lines.translation: But if the soul-bride follows the Will of her Lord and Master,

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dar ghar sobhaa mahal bulaaee ||
lines.translation: She shall be honored in her own home, and called to the Mansion of His Presence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮੀ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak karamee ih mat paaee ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, by His Mercy, this understanding is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee sach samaaee ||1||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, she is absorbed into the True One. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਭੁਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh naam vihooniaa ra(n)g kasu(n)bhaa dekh na bhul ||
lines.translation: O self-willed manmukh, devoid of the Naam, do not be misled upon beholding the color of the safflower.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸ ਕਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਦਿਨ ਥੋੜਿਆ ਛੋਛਾ ਇਸ ਦਾ ਮੁਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: is kaa ra(n)g din thoRiaa chhochhaa is daa mul ||
lines.translation: Its color lasts for only a few days-it is worthless!

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੇ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojai lage pach mue moorakh a(n)dh gavaar ||
lines.translation: Attached to duality, the foolish, blind and stupid people waste away and die.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੀਟ ਸੇ ਪਇ ਪਚਹਿ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: bisataa a(n)dar keet se pai pachahi vaaro vaar ||
lines.translation: Like worms, they live in manure, and in it, they die over and over again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਰੰਗੁਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rate se ra(n)gule gur kai sahaj subhaai ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam are dyed in the color of truth; they take on the intuitive peace and poise of the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bhagatee ra(n)g na utarai sahaje rahai samaai ||2||
lines.translation: The color of devotional worship does not fade away; they remain intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਸਭ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sisat upaaee sabh tudh aape rijak sa(n)baahiaa ||
lines.translation: You created the entire universe, and You Yourself bring sustenance to it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਵਲੁ ਛਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਖਾਵਦੇ ਮੁਹਹੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਤਿਨੀ ਢਾਹਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik val chhal kar kai khaavade muhahu kooR kusat tinee dhaahiaa ||
lines.translation: Some eat and survive by practicing fraud and deceit; from their mouths they drop falsehood and lies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਓਤੈ ਕੰਮਿ ਓਇ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh aape bhaavai so karahi tudh otai ka(n)m oi laaiaa ||
lines.translation: As it pleases You, You assign them their tasks.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਸਚੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਓਨੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਅਤੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਦੇਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikanaa sach bujhaaion tinaa atut bha(n)daar devaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Some understand Truthfulness; they are given the inexhaustible treasure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ਖਾਹਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਅਚੇਤਾ ਹਥ ਤਡਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: har chet khaahi tinaa saphal hai achetaa hath tadaaiaa ||8||
lines.translation: Those who eat by remembering the Lord are prosperous, while those who do not remember Him stretch out their hands in need. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਬੇਦ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਸੁਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: paR paR pa(n)dit bed vakhaanahi maaiaa moh suaai ||
lines.translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars, constantly read and recite the Vedas, for the sake of the love of Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਮਨ ਮੂਰਖ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojai bhaai har naam visaariaa man moorakh milai sajaai ||
lines.translation: In the love of duality, the foolish people have forgotten the Lord's Name; they shall receive their punishment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਜੋ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin jeeu pi(n)d ditaa tis kabahoo(n) na chetai jo de(n)daa rijak sa(n)baahi ||
lines.translation: They never think of the One who gave them body and soul, who provides sustenance to all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਫਾਹਾ ਗਲਹੁ ਨ ਕਟੀਐ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jam kaa phaahaa galahu na kateeai phir phir aavai jaai ||
lines.translation: The noose of death shall not be cut away from their necks; they shall come and go in reincarnation over and over again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh kichhoo na soojhai a(n)dhule poorab likhiaa kamaai ||
lines.translation: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not understand anything. They do what they are pre-ordained to do.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: poorai bhaag satigur milai sukhadaataa naam vasai man aai ||
lines.translation: Through perfect destiny, they meet the True Guru, the Giver of peace, and the Naam comes to abide in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਸੁਖੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh maanahi sukh painanaa sukhe sukh vihaai ||
lines.translation: They enjoy peace, they wear peace, and they pass their lives in the peace of peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਨਾਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak so naau manahu na visaareeai jit dar sachai sobhaa paai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they do not forget the Naam from the mind; they are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sev sukh paaiaa sach naam gunataas ||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, peace is obtained. The True Name is the Treasure of Excellence.
